capabilities: transcribe microphone audio with iFlytek online ASR
read selected text or the current note with iFlytek TTS
start voice workflows with configurable wake words
send recognized text to Gemini, OpenRouter, or iFlytek Spark
insert conversation results into the active note
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian desktop 1.7.2+ and microphone permission). README warns that provider credentials are stored unencrypted in data.json, that providers may charge fees, and that wake-word/continuous-listening modes keep the microphone and network active until stopped. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in voice recognition, speech synthesis, or wake-word control, so voice-driven dictation and AI chat require external tools.
